description: Two dancers trade places, one swooping out round the other.

walkthrough.line: Turn out of the set and swoop round the dancer along the line from you, into their place.
walkthrough.teach: Turn out of the set: if you are on the right, look up the hall and swoop out to your right. Walk round the dancer standing along the line from you, outside the line, into the place they were in, while they step in along the inside to take the place you have left. The two of you have traded places.
